roi.rationale: Complete enclosing outer-wall extent; includes walls for quality and every free cell, including inaccessible center strips. No policy-result-based trimming.

quality.rationale: Correct-known accuracy and dangerous false-free bound; IoU includes unobserved wall interiors. The .20 floor is calibrated from declared geometry and prior development baselines (.22/.25), before any MR3 run; no post-failure lowering. False-free denominator is all truth occupied cells.

scope: Future validation task; static geometry checked only. No P1A policy or simulator run is permitted.
